skillFull: Creates Power Jellies on top of Basic Jellies in a set sequence at certain intervals. Earn additional points for all Jellies, Bear Jellies, and Colorful Star Jellies while in Blast Mode. Level Up for more Energy restored from Potions created by the Pet and even more points for the above Jellies while in Blast Mode.
story: This ghost is the spirit of a faithful butler that oversaw the management of an ancient mansion. His loyalty to this household was so engrained into his very being that even after he passed away, his soul continues to haunt the mansion while going about his incredibly tight schedule with the ease of a pro. Does he ever take a break? Nobody knows.

costumes.name: Full Moon Party Planner
costumes.info: Ghost Butler has taken charge of managing the Pumpkin Moon Party schedule. From delivering invitations made of chocolate parchment to hanging jack-o'-lanterns to light up the venue, setting tables, and greeting guests... They say its working non-stop. But judging by the cheerful tune its humming, it seems the Pet is enjoying the party preparations!
